item: Row 367 batch 3: Settings Leads catalogue and model lines follow a language switch
summary: Nine frozen renderers in app-settings.js (loadCardCatalog, renderCardCatalog, cardSetEnabled, saveCardSettings, saveLlmBehaviour, the Copy button's done, loadCustomModelBox, pullModel, _llmPullRefresh) now draw through ooLive/ooLiveHtml from state they already hold, so a language switch redraws them with no request; their 9 lines leave configs/i18n_frozen_renderers.txt. No new strings. The Leads catalogue is ONE render (_cardCatalogHtml) that starts from the form as it stands (_cardFormState): unsaved ticks and typed values, and open families and folds, survive a switch; a fresh read draws the stored values and keeps open families. The family counter is redrawn by that render (focus goes back to the clicked box), never written beside it. Copied is held and released, so a second click no longer leaves Copied as the button label. Driven as real code by settings_models_live_node_test.js.
